key_insight: An explainable AI model combining mammograms and radiology reports improved biopsy-outcome prediction over image-only and text-only models.
clinical_relevance: The approach may help identify benign findings among patients recommended for breast biopsy, but the reported results do not establish that biopsies can safely be avoided.
method: Extracted mammography features with a Vision Transformer and report embeddings with DeBERTa-V3-Large.
Combined image and text features through late fusion to predict biopsy outcomes.
Used Grad-CAM to highlight image regions influencing predictions.
evidence_signal: Using an in-house dataset of 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a report, the model achieved test AUC 0.72 versus 0.66 for images alone and 0.68 for text alone; specificity was 18% at 99% sensitivity.
watch_item: External and prospective validation are needed before clinical use; performance on one in-house dataset does not establish safe biopsy reduction.
paper_title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
